claims.statement: Deferred simultaneous local decisions target large-graph neural decoding costs.
A parallel include/exclude/defer policy with cleanup and coupled-solution diversity reward constructs independent sets.
Four-layer width-128 graph networks train with per-vertex PPO clipping and 20000 updates.
Task-specific features, rewards and cleanup changes adapt the framework without evidence of one common multitask checkpoint.
BA two-million base LwD achieves 915887 in 276 seconds versus KaMIS 909988 in 3637 seconds; WS500k is a quality counterexample.
Base and local-search variant differ materially on ER400-500 and SATLIB; the latter does not dominate KaMIS on SATLIB.
Extra-task comparisons use a five-second CPLEX budget and selected IQP formulations, not all specialized solvers.
Baselines use documented queue/curriculum adaptations; model selection, samples and per-graph-type tuning belong to the protocol.
